title: Hollowed Kenyan Bread Wrap
description: A yeasty, shattering Kenyan festival bread filled with a lacquer‑glazed San Marzano tomato sauce, wrapped in a fresh corn husk.
instructions: In a bowl combine flour, yeast, sugar, and salt.
Stir in warm milk and melted butter until a shaggy dough forms.
Add the egg and mix until dough comes together.
Knead on a floured surface for about 8 minutes until smooth.
Place dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise until doubled, about 90 minutes.
Punch down the dough, shape into oval rolls, and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes until golden.
While the bread cools, whisk tomato puree with olive oil and a pinch of salt to make the glaze.
Slice cooled rolls horizontally, hollow the center leaving a thin crust.
Fill each hollow with the tomato glaze, spread evenly, and drizzle additional olive oil for a lacquer sheen.
Wrap each filled roll in a soaked corn husk, tie loosely with kitchen twine, and serve warm.
